newsitem.title: USA: Information Resources Q3 U.S. income up.
newsitem.headline: Information Resources Q3 U.S. income up.

text.p: Information Resources Inc said Monday its third quarter results improved due to substantial gains in the United States and reduced losses in Europe.
Information Resources, which gathers and provides electronic scanner-based sales data, said revenues from its U.S. businesses were $86.8 million, up 18 percent from $73.4 million from a year ago.
U.S. operating earnings for the quarter were $8.2 million, compared with a year-ago loss of $7.7 million.
Third quarter international revenues were $15.1 million, up from $10.5 million last year.
Operating losses from international businesses were $7.4 million in the third quarter, compared to a loss of $10.2 million a year ago.
Earlier, Information Resources reported break-even earnings for the third quarter. A year ago, it had a net loss of $4.8 million, or $0.19 a share.

The 1995 results included a nonrecurring pre-tax gain of $41.1 million attributable to the sale of a portion of its software business, a nonrecurring pre-tax charge of $22.8 million and $7.0 million of special charges.

Although progress has been made, international results continued to reflect a difficult competitive environment in Europe, the ramp-up of Italian operations and high retailer data costs in the United Kingdom, the company said.

"...(W)e wish we could report more improvement in the pricing environment, but that is not yet the case either in the U.S. or Europe," Gian Fulgoni, chief executive officer, said in a statement. "Nonetheless, as we have said in the past, we view fair pricing as a key element in our efforts to improve overall margins and we continue to work toward that end."
